competences.description: Attacks all enemies to grant Suppression for 2 turns.

The first hit removes all harmful effects on the boss and transfers all removed harmful effects to all enemies with a 50% chance. The second and third hits block them from removing harmful effects for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Suppression.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy granted with Harmful Effect Removal Blocked. When attacking enemies granted with Suppression, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that ignores all damage reduction effects. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
